title: Malicious code in @iky-zan/baileys (npm)
description: The npm package @iky-zan/baileys version 0.1.0 declares a dependency on libsignal via an unpinned GitHub repository reference. This means that during installation, npm fetches the latest code from the repository head without integrity checks or version pinning. The referenced repository is controlled by a third party unrelated to the package publisher, allowing potentially malicious code to be executed on the installer's machine. This creates a supply chain risk where the installed code can change at any time without updates to the package itself.
